title: Volve (real data): flow over the Hugin Fm top
attribution: Volve dataset, Equinor ASA and the former Volve licence partners (ExxonMobil, Bayerngas); Volve Terms and Conditions (based on CC BY 4.0; not to be sold); processed by seismic_art
flow_note: flow follows steepest descent: toward increasing time

grid.row_note: row 0 is the southern edge; rows run north

critical_note: high = local minimum of time (shallow; flow runs away), low = local maximum (deep; flow converges); relief = how far the time stands from the median of a ring of surroundings; value = mean attribute within the same radius; saddle = flat point with two deeper and two shallower lobes (relief = the weakest lobe), axis_deg = direction of the deeper lobes (counter-clockwise from east, 0-180)
notes: values are relative; compare within this file only
structure = picked time; the dip is the slope of a local plane fitted to the picks in a Gaussian window of 150 coordinate units, on a regular map grid of 30.2641-unit cells (238 x 184)
dip is APPARENT: time change per map distance, not converted to depth

Volve ST10010 PSDM full stack (3-41 degrees), depth-to-time converted, 4 ms; domain TIME and quantity AMPLITUDE as stated by the user from the text header; polarity unknown (not stated in the headers)
time-vs-depth check (seismic_lib): leans time; the cube is blank above about 204 ms (shallow mute), so its own seabed cannot be used
water bottom from the interpreters' horizons: 111 ms TWT and 91 m depth over the survey; read as time it implies 82 m of water, read as depth 111 m: only time fits
structure = the interpreted Hugin Fm top (picked on the near stack, windows cut from the full stack); smoothed over 150 m
source_label: ST10010, full stack, PSDM Kirchhoff, name ends _T
